accent.piSurface: Picker title, selected row/cursor, status headings; Mermaid arrows
accent.claudeSurface: Dialog titles, selected items, diagram source
accent.note: Not the Claude brand color by name. Pi selected labels and headings share accent; Claude selected model is green, login option lavender and title bold lavender. Mermaid geometry has no direct referent.

border.piSurface: Generic dialog separators (also Pi-only tree borders)
border.note: Captured comparable dialogs agree. Does not certify tree borders or missing dialog bottom-border geometry.

borderAccent.piSurface: Focused border in Pi compaction/session-tree UI
borderAccent.note: Only observed in Pi compaction tree; Claude captures have no corresponding tree focus state. Do not substitute the editor border.

borderMuted.piSurface: Mermaid node box outlines; generic subdued component borders
borderMuted.note: Claude renders source, not node boxes. No border cells correspond to Pi node outlines.

success.note: The check is an actual successful/current selection indicator, not gray explanatory text. Catalog-refresh and Pi tree notices remain Pi-specific; no claim about unobserved success notifications.

error.note: Tool failure output is toolOutput, not this role; do not merge its red with this yellow API failure.

warning.piSurface: Warning notifications, including configured-provider restriction in model picker
warning.claudeSurface: No warning notification observed in comparable Claude picker
warning.note: Claude model descriptions are not warnings; the CSV gray mapping is a false textual alignment. Warning state exists conceptually, but supplied captures do not establish a same-surface value. Unverified is a parity blocker, not pi-only.

muted.claudeSurface: Secondary text, cancel hint, tool metadata
muted.note: Gray help text is common but not uniform in attributes; the compaction disclosure uses terminal default plus dim. A single role cannot impose contextual italic/dim.

dim.piSurface: Key hints, footer, minor descriptions and compaction expand key
dim.note: Literal ctrl+o compaction hint is default+dim, not gray. Login cancel hint is gray italic; other hints gray plain.

text.piSurface: Unselected picker rows, ordinary text and diagram labels
text.claudeSurface: Unselected dialog options and ordinary prose
text.note: Exclude selected rows and bold headings owned by other roles. Mermaid source-versus-diagram remains a structural blocker separately.

thinkingText.piSurface: Expanded thinking content and italic collapsed thinking label
thinkingText.note: Claude capture hides the actual reasoning; shared words in final assistant prose do not measure thinking text. Pi forces italic; Claude visible thought label is not italic and its duration alone is bold. Cannot certify expanded content or duplicate this structure with a foreground role.

selectedBg.claudeSurface: Dialog selection is foreground cursor/label; no captured selected transcript region
selectedBg.note: Cannot infer mouse selection from a picker. Claude dialog selected items use lavender/green foreground on default background, not Pi selectedBg. Trees are Pi-only; transcript selection remains unobserved.

scrollbarTrack.claudeSurface: Detailed transcript scrolling without a visible scrollbar
scrollbarTrack.note: Probe proves these Pi roles paint foreground, contrary to CSV background label. Claude fullscreen-scrollbar and fullscreen-search captures contain no visible track/thumb. A theme cannot remove Pi glyph geometry; no measured scrollbar color is available.

scrollbarThumb.claudeSurface: Detailed transcript scrolling without a visible scrollbar
scrollbarThumb.note: Probe proves these Pi roles paint foreground, contrary to CSV background label. Claude fullscreen-scrollbar and fullscreen-search captures contain no visible track/thumb. A theme cannot remove Pi glyph geometry; no measured scrollbar color is available.

searchMatchBg.claudeSurface: Reverse-video search hits, with special current-hit emphasis
searchMatchBg.note: Claude emits SGR inverse over default fg/bg; current hit additionally uses ANSI3 foreground, bold and underline. Setting a foreground/background role cannot emit SGR inverse or express current-vs-other hits. Do not resolve inverse/default to a guessed RGB.

searchMatchText.claudeSurface: Reverse-video search hits, with special current-hit emphasis
searchMatchText.note: Claude emits SGR inverse over default fg/bg; current hit additionally uses ANSI3 foreground, bold and underline. Setting a foreground/background role cannot emit SGR inverse or express current-vs-other hits. Do not resolve inverse/default to a guessed RGB.

userMessageBg.note: All supplied SCENE prompt cells agree. Shell commands have a separate #413c41 surface, listed Claude-only, not silently folded into ordinary user prompts.

userMessageText.note: Read directly from parser runs; coordinates are zero-based terminal columns. Scope is the supplied captured surface, not unobserved states.

customMessageBg.piSurface: Custom messages and compaction-summary panel background
customMessageBg.note: Background itself is consistently default, but disclosure is dim and expanded summary plain. Strict color-plus-attributes classification therefore needs contextual rendering, not a measured all-attributes match. Generic extension custom messages and branch summaries are Pi-only.

customMessageText.piSurface: Collapsed and expanded compaction summary body
customMessageText.note: Collapsed disclosure is default+dim, expanded summary body default plain. Pi one foreground role cannot choose those attributes.

customMessageLabel.claudeSurface: Compaction disclosure without a separate label
customMessageLabel.note: Claude has no separately styled compaction heading; its single dim disclosure cannot be recreated by coloring Pi bold label independently. Generic extension labels are Pi-only, but compaction is comparable.

toolPendingBg.note: Read actual pending command, not the echoed submitted prompt. Only one pending capture exists; no animation extrapolation.

toolSuccessBg.piSurface: Successful tool panel background, including edit diff
toolSuccessBg.note: One panel background cannot supply per-line and intra-line backgrounds. These background surfaces also appear in claudeOnly because no dedicated Pi diff background roles exist.

toolErrorBg.note: Background itself is consistently default. Strict style observation differs between bold tool name and plain output; foreground/title rendering must preserve that distinction. This is not evidence for a red error background.

toolTitle.claudeSurface: Expanded tool name versus collapsed tool summary
toolTitle.note: Bold default tool names collapse to gray descriptions with only numeric count bold. A single foreground role plus Pi fixed title bold cannot represent both.

toolOutput.note: Failure output red, successful text default; Read summary selectively bold. Do not mistake assistant success/failure prose for output.

mdHeading.note: Read directly from parser runs; coordinates are zero-based terminal columns. Scope is the supplied captured surface, not unobserved states.

mdLink.note: Label is plain default, not underlined.

mdLinkUrl.note: Read directly from parser runs; coordinates are zero-based terminal columns. Scope is the supplied captured surface, not unobserved states.

mdCode.note: Mermaid rendered diagram is not inline code; no claim that source text measures its node styling.

mdCodeBlock.claudeSurface: Language-less code and unsupported Mermaid source
mdCodeBlock.note: Plain fence uses lavender; unsupported Mermaid fence is default. Syntax-highlighted tokens are independently classified, not counted as mdCodeBlock conflicts. Pi actually renders Mermaid diagrams, so that branch additionally needs structural rendering work.

mdCodeBlockBorder.piSurface: Visible opening/closing fence and language label
mdCodeBlockBorder.claudeSurface: No visible fences; Mermaid language label only
mdCodeBlockBorder.note: Claude omits fence glyphs altogether, except a dim language label for Mermaid. A color role cannot hide Pi fences or convert a fence to the standalone label.

mdQuote.note: Read directly from parser runs; coordinates are zero-based terminal columns. Scope is the supplied captured surface, not unobserved states.

mdQuoteBorder.note: Read directly from parser runs; coordinates are zero-based terminal columns. Scope is the supplied captured surface, not unobserved states.

mdHr.note: CSV aligned to editor border at row36 incorrectly. Claude displays literal --- with default foreground. Geometry is distinct from Pi full-width line; foreground evidence does not certify geometry.

mdListBullet.note: Read directly from parser runs; coordinates are zero-based terminal columns. Scope is the supplied captured surface, not unobserved states.

toolDiffAdded.piSurface: Added diff line foreground including marker/text
toolDiffAdded.note: Not one green foreground: gutter green, body off-white, keywords cyan/pink, numbers purple. Background matching is separately required.

toolDiffRemoved.piSurface: Removed diff line foreground including marker/text
toolDiffRemoved.note: Gutter red, removed content off-white. Pi single removed foreground cannot paint the two independently; red backgrounds are separate surfaces.

toolDiffContext.claudeSurface: Context line syntax and dim gutter
toolDiffContext.note: A context line has multiple syntax foregrounds and only its gutter dim; not a single context gray.

syntaxComment.note: Preserve ANSI2, not its measured terminal RGB. The earlier ordinary prose word retries is not a comment.

syntaxKeyword.claudeSurface: TS/JS/SQL keywords and HTML tag names
syntaxKeyword.note: Diff highlighting uses different Pi diff roles and a different Claude palette; not merged into this code-fence role.

syntaxFunction.piSurface: Pi highlighted function spans, including parameters/return annotation punctuation
syntaxFunction.claudeSurface: Function names and surrounding declaration span
syntaxFunction.note: Probe Pi markdown row21 col24 contains request( and row21 col44 contains ): Promise<Response>; Claude splits those spans into ANSI3 names, default punctuation, ANSI4 type names. CSV request() was inline code, not function syntax.

contexts.surface: Opening paren in same Pi role span
Return-type name in same Pi role span

syntaxVariable.piSurface: HTML attributes and TS parameter span
syntaxVariable.claudeSurface: HTML class attribute and TS url parameter
syntaxVariable.note: Pi params span includes colon/space but Claude only name ANSI6, colon default. No single foreground matches the actual probe span.

syntaxString.note: Read directly from parser runs; coordinates are zero-based terminal columns. Scope is the supplied captured surface, not unobserved states.

syntaxNumber.note: Read directly from parser runs; coordinates are zero-based terminal columns. Scope is the supplied captured surface, not unobserved states.

syntaxType.note: Pi built_in/type share syntaxType; Claude console is terminal default while string is ANSI6.

syntaxOperator.note: Compare actual SQL operator cells, not an absent token alignment.

syntaxPunctuation.note: Scoped to probe-observed HTML punctuation; unhighlighted JS punctuation is not assigned this Pi role in these captures.

thinkingOff.note: Pi encodes reasoning level by editor border color. Claude has an effort badge but its ordinary editor rule is not a per-level indicator; there is no corresponding seven-level border state. Medium token aligns to rule glyphs only by geometry, not semantics.

bashMode.claudeSurface: Submitted shell command marker and panel; active shell editor not captured
bashMode.note: shell-mode capture is still detailed transcript search/scroll, not a Bash editor. shell-run shows pink ! marker and #413c41 submitted-command background, but no active Bash-entry border. Cannot use ordinary #888888 rule or dim transcript separator as bashBorder proof.
